title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Pores in metal-oxide nanocatalysts can improve electrocatalysis through transport pathways, greater exposed surface, and altered coordination near pore edges.
explanation: The review associates porosity with electrolyte and gas-bubble transport, access to surface atoms, and potentially active low-coordination sites.
conditions: Pore size, density, and morphology influence whether these advantages are realized.
caveats: The identity of active sites and the relationship between their electronic states and catalytic selectivity remain unresolved in many systems.
